ALLEGED SLAYER OF DR. HSI
ARRESTED BY S.M.P.

MOVING SWIFTLY TO ROUND UP **〔此处转录不清〕** GANGSTERS
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE SLAYING OF DR. HSI SHIH-TAI, 45-YEAR-OLD
SECRETARY OF THE POLICE BUREAU OF THE SPECIAL MUNICIPALITY OF
GREATER SHANGHAI, S.M.P. CONSTABLES YESTERDAY (TUE) NABBED
THE ALLEGED KILLER IN THE PAOLUNG HOSPITAL ON
PARK ROAD A FEW HOURS AFTER THE CRIME; IT WAS ANNOUNCED YES-
TERDAY EVENING.

DR. HSI, WHO WAS EDUCATED IN JAPAN, WAS SHOT
DOWN AS HE LEFT HIS HOME IN THE LOUZA DISTRICT YESTERDAY
MORNING.

THE ALLEGED ASSASSIN GAVE HIS NAME AS PENG FU-
LIN, 23, A NATIVE OF SOOCHOW. HE WAS SHOT IN THE ABDOMEN BY
TWO CHINESE POLICEMEN WHO RUSHED TO THE SCENE OF THE SLAYING.
SUBSEQUENTLY HE MADE HIS ESCAPE WITH OTHER MEN WHO PARTICIP-
ATED IN THE ATTACK ON DR. HSI. KNOWING THAT THE WOUNDED
MAN MUST /SEEK MEDICAL ATTENTION, SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SEARCHED ALL THE HOSPITALS IN THE SURROUNDING AREAS AND FOUND
PENG IN THE PAOLUNG HOSPITAL.
QUESTIONING OF THE ALLEGED SLAYER WAS EXPECTED TO
RESULT IN THE DISCLOSURE OF THE IDENTITY OF OTHER MEMBERS OF
A TERRORIST GANG WITH WHICH PENG IS BELIEVED TO BE CON-
NECTED. --K/KU/GH

涉嫌杀害奚博士者
被工部局警务处逮捕

为迅速围捕对大上海特别市警察局秘书、45岁的奚世泰博士遇害案负责的**〔此处转录不清〕**帮匪，工部局巡捕于昨日（周二）案发数小时后，在派克路（Park Road）的宝隆医院抓获了涉嫌凶手；此事于昨晚宣布。

曾留学日本的奚博士，于昨晨离开其在卢家湾（Louza）地区的住所时遭枪击身亡。

涉嫌刺客自称彭福林（Peng Fu-Lin），23岁，苏州人。他在两名中国警察赶至凶案现场时被击中腹部。随后，他与其他参与袭击奚博士的人一同逃脱。警方知悉伤者必会求医，上海公共租界工部局警务处遂搜查周边所有医院，并在宝隆医院发现了彭某。
预计对这名涉嫌凶手的审讯将揭露与该彭某被认为有联系的一个恐怖帮伙其他成员的身份。--K/KU/GH

STRICTER ANTI-TERRORIST
MEASURES - REQUESTED

    REPRESENTATIONS IN REGARD TO THE ASSASSINATION OF
DR. HSI SHIH-TAI, SECRETARY OF THE POLICE BUREAU OF THE GREAT-
ER SHANGHAI SPECIAL MUNICIPALITY, REQUESTING THE ENFORCEMENT
OF STRICTER MEASURES TO PREVENT TERRORISTIC CRIMES IN THE
SETTLEMENT WERE PRESENTED TO THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
BY THE JAPANESE CONSULAR AUTHORITIES YESTERDAY (MON), ACCORD-
ING TO A COMMUNIQUE ISSUED BY THE JAPANESE CONSULATE-GENERAL
AT 5:30 O'CLOCK MONDAY AFTERNOON.

    DR. HSI WAS MURDERED BY CHINESE GUNMEN IN THE
LOUZA DISTRICT ON APRIL 11.

    THE COMMUNIQUE READS AS FOLLOWS: "MR. YOSHIAKI
MIURA, CONSUL-GENERAL, ACCOMPANIED BY MR. HIDENARI TERASAKI,
CONSUL, AT 3:45 O'CLOCK THIS AFTERNOON CALLED ON MR. C.S.
FRANKLIN, CHAIRMAN OF THE S.M.C., IN REGARD TO THE ASSASSIN-
ATION OF DR. HSI SHIH-TAI ON APRIL 11, AND FILED REPRESENTAT-
IONS WITH HIM CONCERNING THE INCIDENT IN QUESTION.

    "FURTHERMORE MR. MIURA REQUESTED A STRICT ENFORCE-
MENT IN THE FUTURE OF UNDERSTANDINGS REA ED BETWEEN THE JAP-
ANESE AUTHORITIES AND THE S.M.C. ON THE PREVENTION OF TERROR-
ISTIC ACTIONS IN THE SETTLEMENT."

要求采取更严厉的反恐
措施

据日本总领事馆周一下午5时30分发布的公报称，日本领事当局于昨日（周一）向上海公共租界工部局提出交涉，就大上海特别市警察局秘书奚世泰博士遇刺一事，要求在租界内执行更严厉的措施以防范恐怖犯罪。

奚博士于4月11日在卢家湾地区被中国枪手谋杀。

公报内容如下：“三浦义明（Yoshiaki Miura）总领事在今日下午3时45分，由寺崎秀成（Hidenari Terasaki）领事陪同，就4月11日奚世泰博士遇刺一事拜会了工部局主席C.S.富兰克林先生，并就上述事件向他提出了交涉。

“此外，三浦先生要求今后严格执行日本当局与工部局之间就防止租界内恐怖行动所达成的谅解。”
KU/RYH/GH

MAYOR SENDS PROTEST
IN MURDER OF DR. HSI

THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL WAS ACCUSED OF
NEGLIGENCE IN CONTROLLING TERRORISTIC ACTIVITIES IN A PROTEST
YESTERDAY (WED) AFTERNOON
SENT/TO MR. C.S. FRANKLIN, CHAIRMAN OF THE COUNCIL, BY MR. FU
HSIAO-EN, MAYOR OF THE GREATER SHANGHAI SPECIAL MUNICIPAL-
ITY, IN CONNECTION WITH THE MURDER OF DR. HSI SHIH-TAI, SEC-
RETARY OF THE POLICE BUREAU OF THE MUNICIPALITY, ON APRIL 11.

AN OFFICIAL OF THE MUNICIPALITY ACTING AS A REP-
RESENTATIVE OF MAYOR FU CALLED ON MR. FRANKLIN AT THE ADMIN-
ISTRATION BUILDING AT 4 O'CLOCK YESTERDAY AFTERNOON TO DEL-
IVER THE PROTEST.

RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE ASSASSINATION OF DR. HSI
SHOULD REST ON THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL AS GUARDIAN OF
PEACE AND ORDER IN THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT, THE PROTEST
STATED. REPEATED ASSASSINATIONS WHICH HAVE BEEN COMMITTED FOR
SOME TIME IN THE SETTLEMENT AND FRENCH CONCESSION CONSTITUTED
ACTS OF TREASON AGAINST THE NEW REGIME, THE STATEMENT SAID.

IT RECALLED THAT MAYOR FU ON MARCH 10 LODGED A
PROTEST WITH THE S.M.C. CONTAINING FIVE DEMANDS
FOR MEASURES TO BE TAKEN TO SUPPRESS TERRORISTIC CRIMES.

市长就奚博士遇害案
提出抗议

大上海特别市市长傅筱庵先生于昨日（周三）下午致函工部局主席C.S.富兰克林先生，就本市警察局秘书奚世泰博士于4月11日遇害一事提出抗议，指责上海公共租界工部局在控制恐怖活动方面存在疏忽。

昨日午后4时，一名代表傅市长的市政府官员前往行政大楼拜访富兰克林先生，递交了该抗议书。

抗议书称，作为国际租界和平与秩序的维护者，上海公共租界工部局应对奚世泰博士的遇刺承担责任。声明指出，近期在租界及法租界内屡发生的暗杀事件构成了对新政权的叛国行为。

声明回顾道，傅市长曾于3月10日向工部局提出抗议，其中包含五项要求，旨在采取措辞镇压恐怖犯罪。（续下页）

第5号--2
市长发出--2

    抗议书宣称，鉴于至今未获答复，傅市长对工部局的诚意深感不满，而另一起暗杀事件的发生使他怀疑工部局在维持和平与秩序方面的努力是否出于善意。

    市长表示，他对工部局执行逮捕和镇压恐怖分子措施的能力存有疑虑。

    抗议书进一步宣称，傅市长就奚博士遇刺一事“追究”工部局的责任，并要求采取适当措施以防止此类犯罪再次发生。

    声明称，过去租界内频繁的暗杀事件以及奚博士的遇害，均归咎于工部局在采取适当预防措施方面的缺失。

    声明要求工部局对奚博士家属提供赔偿，因其谋杀案被归咎于工部局在履行控制恐怖分子职责时的疏忽。

    声明还要求租界警察与特别市警察合作，以镇压租界内的恐怖主义并搜捕租界内的恐怖分子。声明要求尽早回复，并同时答复傅市长3月10日的抗议。--KU/GH

April 12, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

"WIPE OUT THE CORRUPTING GOVERNMENT AGENTS"

The "Tairiku Shimpo" publishes the
following leading article under the above heading :-

Yesterday Mr. Hsi Shih Tai, Chief
Secretary to the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government,
concurrently Chief of the Health Department and a special member
of the Japanese Military Press Section, was assassinated. We
pay him high respect for the services he has rendered in the
building up of a new order in the Orient and in bringing the
Japanese and Chinese peoples closer.

When the late Foreign Minister Chen
Loh was assassinated, we requested our officers and civilians
and the Chinese officers and people to offer up a one-minute
silent prayer. We now make a similar suggestion.

We must protect at any cost the lives
and property of those Chinese who are working to organize a
co-operative body in East Asia in a pro-Japanese and anti-
Communist spirit.

It is difficult to say whether the
fires and acts of terrorism in occupied areas are acts committed
by anti-Japanese elements and it is not justified to hold the
Japanese authorities responsible for the policing duty because
the places where such fires have broken out and such incidents
have occurred do not come into the question.

However, the existence of Chungking
Government agents in Shanghai, which lies in occupied area, is
a different matter. The S.M.C. is an international organization;
it belongs neither to the Chiang Kai Shek regime nor to the
Japanese Government. Yet it is in touch with the Chungking
Government but ignores the "Reformed Government" and obstructs
Japan's policy.

1939年4月12日。

《大陆新报》

“肃清腐败的政府代理人”

《大陆新报》在上述标题下发表以下社论：

昨日，上海市政府警察局局长兼卫生处处长、日本军方报道部特约成员奚世泰先生遇刺身亡。我们对他在建立东方新秩序以及促进中日人民亲近方面所提供的服务致以崇高的敬意。

当已故外交部长陈箓遇刺时，我们曾请求我方军政人员及中国军政人员与民众默哀一分钟。现在我们提出同样的建议。

我们必须不惜一切代价保护那些本着亲日反共精神致力于在东亚组建合作机构的中国人的生命和财产。

很难说占领区的火灾和恐怖行为是否由反日分子所为，也不能因为发生火灾和此类事件的地点不在管辖范围内而认为日本当局应对警务职责负责，这是没有道理的。

然而，位于占领区内的上海存在重庆政府代理人，则是另一回事。工部局是一个国际组织；它既不属于蒋介石政权，也不属于日本政府。但它却与重庆政府保持联系，而无视“维新政府”，阻碍日本的政策。

（左侧批注：）
E.

The first item of evidence is the fact
that the British Government ignores the "Reformed Government"
and is continuing to support the anti-Japanese policy of the
Chiang Kai Shek regime by causing Ambassador Kerr to visit
Chungking and seeming to maintain close touch with the
Government.

The second piece of evidence is that our
army, navy and consular authorities must have already obtained
a reply from the S.M.C. and Foreign Consuls regarding the
suppression of Chungking Government's anti-Japanese terrorist
organs and anti-Japanese publications, yet the S.M.C. is paying
no attention to the activities of anti-Japanese groups and
permits the papers to register in Foreign Consulates to the
abuse of extraterritoriality. So long as the agents of the
Chungking Government are to be found in Shanghai, this in
itself constitutes the principal cause of the disturbances
of the peace and order in Shanghai. It is useless to make
demands for suppression and to secure pledges from the S.M.C.
which is permitting the existence of anti-Japanese organs.

Japan and China are now engaged in
rebuilding the Orient at the cost of many lives. The new
regimes and the reborn Chinese people are in complete union
with Japan in the rebuilding of China. There is no reason
to permit a power which is obstructing this great work of
rebuilding to exist. Out of consideration for the military
operations and the maintenance of peace and order, a definite
and final measure should be resorted to.

第一项证据是，英国政府无视“维新政府”，并通过派遣克尔大使访问重庆以及看似与政府保持密切联系，继续支持蒋介石政权的反日政策。

第二项证据是，我方海陆军及领事当局肯定已经收到工部局及外国领事关于镇压重庆政府反日恐怖组织和反日刊物的回复，但工部局却对反日团体的活动置若罔闻，并允许报刊在外国领事馆注册，滥用治外法权。只要重庆政府的代理人在上海存在，这本身就构成了扰乱上海和平与秩序的主要原因。向允许反日机构存在的工部局提出镇压要求并获得承诺是徒劳的。

日本和中国正以许多生命为代价重建东方。新政权和重生的中国人民在重建中国方面与日本完全团结。没有理由允许阻碍这一伟大重建工作的势力存在。出于对军事行动及维持和平与秩序的考虑，应采取明确且最终的措施。

April 18, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

"MOVEMENTS OF TERRORISTS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE
ASSASSINATION OF DR. HSI EXPOSED"

As a result of the shot fired
by a Chinese Constable at the assassins of Dr. Hsi, the S.M.P.
obtained a clue to the movements of the terrorists responsible
for the assassination. It is learned that one Yuan Teh Chong,
age 25, the Chief of the gang responsible for the assassination,
has quite a large number of guerrillas in Footung. The gang
receives money and arms from the Chungking Government for
terroristic activities.

Peng Fu Lin, who resides in
the Dah Yuen Sing Lodging House on Rue Palikao, French
Concession, one of the five persons responsible for the
assassination of Dr. Hsi Shih Tai, Secretary of the Police
Bureau of the Shanghai City Government, was arrested when he
was admitted to the Paulun Hospital for medical treatment for
a wound to the right lung caused by a shot fired by C.P.C.
Chao Jong Lai of Louza Police Station during an exchange of
shots with the gang. One Peng Ching Hsia, younger brother of
Peng Fu Lin, and another Chao Ts Hsiang, age 23, residing at
No.11 Vung Kan Li, Rue Lafayette, French Concession, took Peng
Fu Lin to the Paulun Hospital where Chao Ts Hsiang was arrested
but Peng Ching Hsia made good his escape.

Chao Ts Hsiang was taken to
Louza Station where he informed the Police that five persons
were engaged in the assassination of Dr. Hsi. Chao Ts Hsiang
was posted in the middle of the entrance to Chu Yee Li, Lane
No.127 Lloyd Road, the scene of the crime. Peng Fu Lin was
posted on watch duty while Yuen Teh Chong, age 25, armed with
a revolver, and Peng Ching Hsia, carrying a Browning pistol,

1939年4月18日。

《大陆新报》

“负责刺杀奚博士的恐怖分子行踪曝光”

由于一名中国巡捕向奚博士的刺客开枪，工部局警务处获得了负责此次暗杀的恐怖分子行踪的线索。据悉，负责此次暗杀的帮伙头目袁德崇（Yuan Teh Chong），25岁，在浦东拥有相当数量的游击队员。该帮伙从重庆政府获得资金和武器以进行恐怖活动。

居住在法租界白尔部路（Rue Palikao）大元兴客栈的彭福林，是负责刺杀上海市政府警察局局长秘书奚世泰博士的五名责任人之一，他在因肺部右叶中弹受伤而被送往宝隆医院接受治疗时被捕。该枪伤是由卢家湾警署的赵荣来（Chao Jong Lai）警官在与该帮伙交火时射击所致。彭福林的弟弟彭庆霞（Peng Ching Hsia）以及另一名23岁的赵慈祥（Chao Ts Hsiang，居住在法租界辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）涌泉里11号）将彭福林送往宝隆医院，赵慈祥在那里被捕，但彭庆霞成功逃脱。

赵慈祥被带往卢家湾警署，他向警方供述有五个人参与了刺杀奚博士的行动。赵慈祥当时被部署在作案现场——劳合路（Lloyd Road）127弄朱义里的入口中间。彭福林负责放哨，而25岁的袁德崇手持左轮手枪，彭庆霞携带勃朗宁手枪，

constable fell to the ground, they took Feng Fu Lin, who was
wounded, to the Paulun Hospital by ricksha. Another man named
Chang Miao Keng, a native of Chowpu, was posted outside the
entrance of the alleyway for observation duty. Chang Miao
Keng together with Yuen Teh Chong and Feng Ching Hsia made
good their escape.

Dum Dum Bullets used in the Assassination

At 9 a.m. April 12 an inquest on
the body of Dr. Hsi was held in the presence of Japanese
gendarmes and municipal officers at the Municipal mortuary.
Four bullets were taken out, two of which had lodged in the
lung and one each in the right and left breasts. The missiles
were dum dum lead bullets of .38 calibre.

"Shanghai City Government Adopts Strong Attitude :
Formal Protest to be Lodged with the S.M.C."

In connection with the assassination
of Dr. Hsi, Secretary of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City
Government, an official of the government called on Mr. Franklin,
Chairman of the S.M.C., on April 11 and lodged a verbal protest.
The Shanghai City Government is reported to have decided to
lodge a formal and written protest with the S.M.C. to-day or
to-morrow.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

等候奚医生于……点12分离开其寓所。“当医生向弄堂入口方向走了约15或16步时，两名男子向他开了四枪。随后他们从入口左侧逃脱。

赵巡长（J.I.C. Chao）和赖（Lai）被奔跑的脚步声吸引，从背后向逃犯开了几枪，击中了一名正在执行监视任务的逃犯。冯景夏（Feng Ching Hsia）在逃跑时向赵巡长开了一枪，击中其右腋窝。当警员倒地后，他们用黄包车将受伤的冯福林（Feng Fu Lin）送往宝隆医院。另一名男子张妙庚（Chang Miao Keng），周浦人，被部署在弄堂口外执行监视任务。张妙庚与袁德崇（Yuen Teh Chong）及冯景夏成功逃脱。

暗杀中使用的达姆弹

4月12日上午9时，在日本宪兵和工部局官员的见证下，于工部局殓房对奚医生的尸体进行了验尸。取出四颗子弹，其中两颗滞留在肺部，左右乳房各一颗。这些射入物为.38口径的达姆铅弹。

“上海市政府采取强硬态度：拟向工部局提出正式抗议”

就奚医生被暗杀一事，上海市政府警察局秘书、一名政府官员于4月11日拜访了工部局总董富兰克林先生（Mr. Franklin），并提出口头抗议。据悉，上海市政府决定于今日或明日向工部局提出正式的书面抗议。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

MAINICHI

Japanese Residents' Corporation to Give A Sum
of Money to Brave Constable Chao.

It is reported that the Japanese
Residents' Corporation has decided to send a sum of money to
J.P.C. Chao who, although wounded, so bravely discharged his
duty in a gun battle with the gang of terrorists responsible
for the assassination of Dr. Hsi and wounding one of them,
thereby leading to the man's arrest.

One of the offenders is now
detained at the Pai lun Hospital and will be handed over to
the Japanese authorities as soon as he recovers from the
wound in accordance with the understanding reached between
the Japanese authorities and the S.M.C.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

每日新闻

日本居留民团将向勇敢的赵巡长赠送一笔款项

据悉，日本居留民团已决定向赵巡长（J.P.C. Chao）赠送一笔款项。赵巡长在枪战中英勇履行职责，对抗负责暗杀奚医生的恐怖团伙，并击伤其中一人，从而促成该人被捕，尽管他自己也受了伤。

其中一名罪犯目前被拘留在宝隆医院，根据日本当局与工部局达成的谅解，一旦其伤口痊愈，即将移交给日本当局。

page_data.en:
April 12, 1939.

MAINICHI

"AN OFFENDER ARRESTED IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE
ASSASSINATION OF DR. HSI SHIH TAI"

At 9.15 a.m. April 11 Dr. Hsi
Shih Tai, secretary of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai
City Government, was assassinated by two persons at the
entrance of Lane 131 Lloyd road. One of the two offenders
made good his escape but the other man secretly sought
medical treatment at the Paulun Hospital. In the course
of the investigations, the Police authorities learned
that one Peng Fu Lin, age 23, who was admitted to the
Paulun Hospital, was one of the two assassins and placed
the man under arrest.

Constable Chao's merit

When the shooting incident took
place C.P.C. No. 277 Soong Kiang Yung and C.P.C. No. 730
Chao Wong Lai of Louza Police Station, who were on duty
in the vicinity of the scene, rushed to the spot and the
latter exchanged shots with Peng Fu Lin, 23, whose address
is No. 11 Wei Ping Li, Rue Lafayette, French Concession,
and Constable Chao was wounded. Peng went as far as
No. 546 Yu Ya Ching Road but in the vicinity of the
Nanking Hotel(?) he was assisted by a pedestrian named
Chao Tz Hsiang, age 23, to the Paulun Hospital. Later
the Police discovered that the man was in that hospital.
C.P.C. No. 730 has been to Paulun Hospital and identified
the prisoner.

The Louza Police are now making
further investigations regarding Chao Tz Hsiang who
assisted Peng Fu Lin to the hospital. It is not known
whether he is connected with the shooting.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

Important determination of our military authorities
over the assassination of Dr. Hsi

Our military authorities, who
have been maintaining an attitude of toleration towards
the frequent occurrence of anti-Japanese terrorist incidents,
have become extremely indignant over the assassination of
Dr. Hsi. Concluding that sincerity can no longer be
expected from the S.M.C. authorities, our military
authorities will adopt a strong attitude to cope with the
situation.

The victim, Dr. Hsi, was a
brave worker for the construction of new order in the
Orient in co-operation with our authorities.
Our military authorities must
adopt effective and suitable measures to deal with anti-
Japanese publications and agents of the Chungking Government
which are responsible for such publications in the Foreign
Settlements because if such enlightened pro-Japanese
Chinese as Dr. Hsi are to be killed by terrorists, it
would seriously obstruct the new order which we are building
at so heavy cost in the Far East.

1939年4月12日。

每日新闻

“奚世泰医生遇刺后一名罪犯立即被捕”

4月11日上午9时15分，上海市政府警察局秘书奚世泰博士在劳合路131号弄堂口被两人暗杀。两名罪犯中的一人成功逃脱，另一人则秘密前往宝隆医院求医。在调查过程中，警方获悉入住宝隆医院的一名23岁男子彭福林（Peng Fu Lin）是两名刺客之一，遂将其逮捕。

赵巡长的功绩

枪击事件发生时，在案发现场附近执勤的老闸捕房的277号华捕宋江勇（Soong Kiang Yung）和730号华捕赵旺来（Chao Wong Lai）迅速赶至现场，后者与住址为法租界霞飞路伟平里11号的23岁男子彭福林交火，赵巡长受伤。彭逃至亚尔培路546号，但在南京饭店（?）附近，在一位名叫赵子祥（Chao Tz Hsiang）、23岁的行人的协助下前往宝隆医院。后来警方发现该人在那家医院。730号华捕前往宝隆医院并指认了该囚犯。

老闸捕房目前正在对协助彭福林去医院的赵子祥进行进一步调查。尚不清楚他是否与枪击案有关。

大陆新报

日军当局对奚医生被暗杀案的重要决定

我军当局一直对频繁发生的反日恐怖事件持容忍态度，但对奚医生被暗杀一事感到极为愤怒。鉴于不再能期望工部局当局表现出诚意，我军当局将采取强硬态度以应对局势。

受害者奚医生是一位与我方当局合作、致力于构建东方新秩序的勇敢工作者。
我军当局必须采取有效且适当的措施，对付公共租界内那些对此类出版物负有责任的反日出版物及重庆政府代理人，因为如果像奚医生这样开明的亲华人士被恐怖分子杀害，将严重阻碍我们在远东付出巨大代价所建立的新秩序。

At 5.30 p.m. May 9th, 1939, Mr.
Hashidzume, Chancellor of the Japanese Consular
Police, requested assistance in effecting the arrest
of an alleged guerilla at 200 Shanse Road.
Assistance was rendered by D.S. Bradley
and party. The whole party proceeded to the Nanking
Hotel, 200 Shanse Road, in order to visit the
telephone exchange room. D.S. Bradley informed the
Consular Police that he believed the man they were
wanting had already been arrested on suspicion of
being connected in the murder of Dr. Shih (Subject of
this file). No proof of complicity had been proved
however and he had been released on guarantor.
Mr. Hashidzume stated that information
which they had to hand was to the effect arms and
ammunition were stored in the telephone room. This
was thoroughly searched but nothing whatever of that
nature was unearthed.
The foregoing was related to the
undersigned on the morning of May 10th. The guarantor
of Poo Foh Sing (浦福新), one named Lee Fah Tsan
(李百川), employed by the Nanking and Central Hotels,
was called to Crime Branch Headquarters during the
morning of May 10th re locating Poo Foh Sing.

1939年5月9日下午5时30分，日本领事馆警察署长桥爪先生（Mr. Hashidzume）请求协助在山西路200号逮捕一名涉嫌游击队员。
布拉德利副侦探长（D.S. Bradley）及其组员提供了协助。全体人马前往山西路200号的南京饭店，以查看电话交换机房。布拉德利副侦探长告知领事馆警察，他认为他们要找的人此前因涉嫌与席医生（本案主题）谋杀案有关而被捕。然而，共犯证据并未得到证实，他已由保人担保释放。
桥爪先生表示，他们掌握的情报显示武器和弹药储存在电话室内。经过彻底搜查，未发现任何此类物品。
上述情况于5月10日上午向签署人汇报。浦福新（Poo Foh Sing）的保人李百川（Lee Fah Tsan），受雇于南京饭店和中央饭店，于5月10日上午被召至刑事部总部，以确定浦福新的下落。

He explained that on Poo Poh Sing being
arrested on suspicion by Police on April 11th and
being released during the evening of April 13th, he
was discharged by the Nanking Hotel on his re-appearing
for work as a telephone operator. Since that time he
had seen him on two occasions and therefore doubted
his ability to locate him immediately.

At 4.30 p.m. May 10th, No. 57 Yunnan Road
was visited. It was learnt there that Poo Poh Sing
had returned there after his release by Police but had
not remained. A visit was also paid to the Great
Shanghai Hotel, Tientsin Road, where friends and
acquaintances of Poo Poh Sing worked. They denied
having seen him for some considerable time or knowing
his present whereabouts.

In order to impress on Lee Pah Tsou the
necessity of locating Poo Poh Sing for questioning,
he was told he would be temporarily detained. He then
got in touch with friends to whom he explained the
necessity of locating Poo Poh Sing. These have proved
unproductive of result.

The reason of the temporary detention of
Lee Pah Tsou was explained to Mr. Smith (P.A. to D.C.
(Crime) and concurrently in charge C.I.D. (C.B.R.C.)) He
page_data.zh:

他解释说，浦福新于4月11日因涉嫌被警方逮捕，并于4月13日晚获释后，当他重新出现担任电话接线员工作时，已被南京饭店解雇。自那时起，他只见过他两次，因此怀疑自己能否立即找到他。

5月10日下午4时30分，警方走访了云南路57号。据获悉，浦福新在被警方释放后曾返回此处，但未久留。警方还走访了天津路的大上海酒店，浦福新的朋友和熟人在那里工作。他们否认在近段时间内见过他或知道其当前下落。

为了让李柏佐（Lee Pah Tsou，注：前文为李百川，此处音译略有差异，依原文译出）明白寻找浦福新接受讯问的必要性，被告知他将被暂时拘留。随后他联系了朋友，向他们解释了寻找浦福新的必要性。但这些努力均未产生结果。

As he approached it he heard two shots and
realised that Yuen Tuh Tsong had opened fire
therefore he immediately ordered the watchman
not to move and then saw a C.P.C. (730, at tenant
3) stand up from inside the hut and immediately
fired one shot at him. He returned the fire and
Beng Poh Ling received a bullet wound in the chest.
This injury however did not immediately in-
capacitate him and, still clutching the revolver
which he later placed inside his clothing, he
made a hurried escape down the lane and through
the back door of hot water shop, 544 Yu Ya Ching
Road and onto Yu Ya Ching Road where he hired a
public rickshaw and proceeded to the Dah Tung Sing
Lodging House, 94 Hum Pallane, Y.C. and called on
Lee Yung Ho (statement 7) to assist him to the
Nanking Hotel.
On reaching the Nanking Hotel, Beng Poh Ling
left Lee Kyang Ho on a lower floor, and made his
way to the fourth floor by the stairway, where he
was met by Zau Ta Siang who had made his way back
to the hotel immediately after the shooting.
Almost at the same time he saw Yuen Tuh Tsong
page_data.zh:
Q/第18张。

他走向坐在弄内几码处岗亭里的看守。
当他走近时，听到两声枪响，意识到袁土宗已经开火，因此他立即命令看守不要动，然后看到一名中央公园巡捕（730号，租户3号）从岗亭内站起来，并立即向他开了一枪。他还击，邦波林胸部中弹。
然而，这一伤势并未立即使他丧失行动能力，他仍紧握着后来塞进衣服里的左轮手枪，匆忙沿弄堂逃跑，穿过鱼雅清路544号热水店的后门，来到鱼雅清路上，在那里雇了一辆公共黄包车，前往法租界汉密尔顿路94号大通兴旅社，并求助于李永好（供词7）协助他前往南京饭店。
到达南京饭店后，邦波林让李京浩留在较低楼层，自己沿楼梯上到四楼，在那里遇到了枪击发生后立即返回饭店的赵塔祥（Zau Ta Siang）。几乎同时，他看到了袁土宗

page_data.en:
2/shot 13.

to see he returned the revolver. Lau Ts Xiang
was told to bring Ong Poh Ling to the Outram Hospital
and they were taken down the stairs and were met
by Lee Kiang Ha who later accompanied them to the
hospital with results as already related.

What Yuan Tuh Tseng went or what he did
with the revolver after his meeting Ong Poh Ling is
not known. He did not return to room 411 because,
had he done so, a bill for a broken glass table
top would have been presented by the room boy.
Ong Poh Ling and Lau Ts Xiang stated they had no
knowledge of how the glass was broken.

....................

Of the three immediately concerned in the
murder of Dr. Chih it would appear that Yuan Tuh
Tseng was the prime mover and he himself received
instructions from someone else.

The fingerprints of Lau Ts Xiang (detained)
and Ong Poh Ling (deceased) show they have no
previous records. They have been photographed.

The three .38 revolver bullets (two found in
the deceased victim's clothing and one extracted
from his body) were fired from one revolver which
has no previous records. (See A.I.D. report).

....................
page_data.zh:
2/页 13。

见他交回了左轮手枪。刘子祥（Lau Ts Xiang，音译）奉命将翁伯灵（Ong Poh Ling，音译）带往奥特拉姆医院（Outram Hospital），他们走下楼梯时遇到了李江海（Lee Kiang Ha，音译），后者随后陪同他们前往医院，结果如前所述。

袁笃增（Yuan Tuh Tseng，音译）在与翁伯灵会面后去了哪里，或者他对那把左轮手枪做了什么，均不得而知。他没有返回411号房间，因为如果他回去了，侍者会出示一张玻璃桌面破损的赔偿单。翁伯灵和刘子祥称，他们对玻璃是如何破碎的毫不知情____

在直接涉及季博士谋杀案的三人中，袁笃增似乎是主谋，而他本人则是受他人指使。

刘子祥（被拘留）和翁伯灵（已故）的指纹显示他们此前无犯罪记录。他们已被拍照存档。

三枚.38口径左轮手枪子弹（两枚在死者衣物中发现，一枚从体内取出）系由同一把此前无记录的左轮手枪射出。（参见情报处报告）____

page_data.en:
2/Sheet 14.

Detectives, with assist nco of French Police,
were posted at No. 1 Vung Yee Li, Rue Lafayette
in the event of any person visiting same. Nothing
however transpired and the watch was withdrawn at
6 p.m. on April 18th.
A description of YUNG FUN TANG (袁法堂) is
as follows: -
age about 22, native of Nanking or Wuchang,
height about 5'6", thin build; thin face, pale
complexion, long hair brushed back. Wears
foreign clothes, no hat. Speaks Shanghai
dialect.
Every effort is being made to effect the
apprehension of the above described male.

K.

G.W. Bourne
D. 3. 389.
page_data.zh:
2/页 14。

侦探们在法国警察一名非委任警官的协助下，驻守在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）永义里1号，以防有人造访该处。然而并未发生任何情况，监视于4月18日下午6时撤除。
袁法堂（YUNG FUN TANG）的体貌特征如下：-
年龄约22岁，南京或武昌籍，身高约5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削；脸型瘦长，面色苍白，长发向后梳理。身穿西装，未戴帽子。讲上海话。
正全力缉拿上述男子。

K.

G.W. Bourne
D. 3. 389.

page_data.en:
LEE KYUNG HO ( - ),
Tsingpoo // D.S.I. Yung Ta King.
C.B.H.Q.C.1 13.4.39 translated Clerk S.P.Hsu.
//////

My name is Lee Kyung Ho, age 23 years, native of
Tsingpoo, 3/tea boy, employed at the Dah Tung Shing
Lodging House, 94 Rue Palikao, F.C., and residing at
the same address.

I have been employed as tea boy No. 3 at the above
lodging house for over a year.

At 9.30 a.m. on 11th April 1939, whilst sleeping
in a 4th floor attic, as I was on night duty on that
day, I was awakened by another tea boy, Tsang Ngah
Sung (姜亞生), who informed me that one named Hang
Poh Ling (〔此处转录不清〕) an ex-coolie of the lodging house
was waiting for me on the ground floor.

I got up, put on my clothes and went downstairs,
where, outside the accountant's office, I found Hang
Poh Ling. He then informed me that he had received
a bullet wound at the rear of the San Sun Co. Further,
he asked me to hire two rickshas and assist him to the
Nanking Hotel. These requests I complied with and we
proceeded to Nanking Hotel by two rickshas.

On arrival I paid 30 cents to the ricksha coolies.
Hang Poh Ling asked me to wait for him on the 2nd floor,
whilst he proceeded to the 3rd floor. About 5 minutes
later he came to me in company with another male Chinese,
whom I did not know (i.e. Tan Ta Ziang, now in Police
custody). I was then requested to accompany these two
men to the Paulun Hospital. We went there in rickshas.

The hospital accountant demanded $3.60 a day for
page_data.zh:
李京浩（LEE KYUNG HO，音译），
青浦 // 副督察 荣达卿（Yung Ta King，音译）。
中央捕房总部 C.1 1939年4月13日 翻译 书记员 徐（S.P.Hsu）。
//////

我叫李京浩，23岁，青浦人，职业为茶房（编号3），受雇于法租界白尔部路94号大同兴客栈，并居住于此地址。

我在上述客栈担任3号茶房已有一年多。

1939年4月11日上午9时30分，我当时值夜班，正在四楼阁楼睡觉，被另一名茶房姜亚生（Tsang Ngah Sung）唤醒，他告诉我，客栈的前苦力杭伯灵（Hang Poh Ling，〔此处转录不清〕）正在楼下等我。

我起身穿好衣服下楼，在会计室外面见到了杭伯灵。他随即告知我，他在三新公司后方受了枪伤。此外，他让我雇两辆黄包车，协助他前往南京饭店。我照办了，我们乘坐两辆黄包车前往南京饭店。

到达后，我付给黄包车夫30分。杭伯灵让我在二楼等他，他自己则上了三楼。大约5分钟后，他和一名我不认识的中国男子（即谭子祥（Tan Ta Ziang，音译），现已被警方拘留）一起来到我面前。随后我被要求陪同这两人前往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）。我们乘黄包车前往那里。

医院会计要求支付每天3.60美元的费用，用于

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the detention and treatment of Mang Poh Ling. Whilst
the accountant was thus talking with Zau Ts Ziang (  )
in the former's office, a foreign and Chinese detectives
came in, asking me what position I was holding. In reply,
I told them that I was employed as a tea boy in the Dah
Tung Shing Lodging House.

Seeing the detectives were questioning Zau Ts Ziang
and finding some thing amiss, I slipped out of the hospital
and returned to sleep in the Dah Tung Shing Lodging House.

I do not know Zau Ts Ziang and on the morning of
April 11th, 1939, it was the first time that I met him
when sending the wounded person to hospital.

Later I learned that the Police had, during my absence, visited
the lodging House, where I was employed.

At 11 a.m. 13.4.39 a party of foreign and Chinese
detectives came to our lodging house and brought me to
C.B.H.Q., S.M.Police, where I made a written statement
and identified one prisoner as being the man named Zau
Ts Ziang, who accompanied Mang Poh Ling to hospital together
with me.

I do not know anything regarding the circumstances
in which Mang Poh Ling received his injury.

This is my true statement.

Signed: Lee Kyang Ho.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

孟伯灵（Mang Poh Ling，音译）的留院和治疗。正当会计在其办公室与赵子祥（Zau Ts Ziang，音译）交谈时，几名中外侦探走进来，询问我的职位。我回答说，我是大同兴客栈的茶房。

见侦探正在讯问赵子祥，且察觉情况不妙，我便溜出医院，回到大同兴客栈睡觉。

我不认识赵子祥，1939年4月11日上午送伤者去医院时，是我第一次见到他。

后来我得知，在我离开期间，警方曾到访我就职的客栈。

1939年4月13日上午11时，一队中外侦探来到我们客栈，将我带到工部局警务处中央捕房总部，我在那里作了书面供词，并指认其中一名囚犯就是赵子祥，即当时与我一同陪孟伯灵去医院的那个人。

我对孟伯灵受伤的情况一无所知。

这是我的真实供词。

签名：李京浩（Lee Kyang Ho）。

page_data.en:
Poo Poh Sing ( 〔此处转录不清〕 )
Zengzoh                                            J.S.I. Vung
                                                   translated
C.1, C.B.H.Q.           13/4/39                    //////       Clerk Hsia

My name is Poo Poh Sing, age 25, native of Zengzoh,
single, telephone operator employed at the Nanking Hotel
and residing at No.57 Yu nan Road.

During the month of October, 1939, I secured my job in
the Nanking Hotel. Before that I worked as an operator in the
Chun Nan Hotel (中南飯店) for about five years.

At about 2.30 p.m. 11th. April, 1939, a party of Foreign
and Chinese detectives accompanied by male Chinese (name
unknown) came to the telephone room whilst I was on duty.
They questioned me whether I knew that the male Chinese had
stayed in the hotel. I then told them that he had not stayed
here. I further added that at about 10 a.m. on the 11th.
April, 1939, one named Zau Ts Ziang, a friend of Yuen Teh Chong
(袁德昌) (who formerly worked in the hotel as an
operator) visited me in the telephone room and asked me whether
Yuen had been visited here or not. I replied that he did not
come. At the same time, another unknown male Chinese came in,
enquiring about Yuen and later they left together. Previously
Yuen and Zau have visited the telephone room on three occasions,
but Yuen was one of my old friends, so he frequented the
telephone room by himself. I did not know Yuen's residence.
I also had no knowledge of their (Yuen and Zau) activities.

This is my true statement.

Description of Yuen Teh Chong (not in custody).

Yuen Teh Chong, age about 22/3, native of Sungkiang or
Kwongsan, ht. 5'6", pale complexion, thin face, thin build,
long hair brushed back, wearing foreign clothes, somewhat, speaking
Shanghai dialect.

Sgd. Poo Poh Sing
page_data.zh:
卜宝兴（Poo Poh Sing，音译）〔此处转录不清〕
增佐（Zengzoh，音译）                                            副督察 冯（Vung，音译）
                                                   翻译
C.1, 中央捕房总部           1939年4月13日                    //////       书记员 夏（Hsia）

我叫卜宝兴，25岁，增佐人，未婚，职业为电话接线员，受雇于南京饭店，居住在虞南路57号。

1939年10月期间，我在南京饭店找到了这份工作。在此之前，我在中南饭店（Chun Nan Hotel）担任接线员约五年。

1939年4月11日下午2时30分左右，一队中外侦探陪同一名中国男子（姓名不详）来到电话间，当时我正在值班。他们问我是否认识那名曾在酒店住宿的中国男子。我告诉他们他并未在此住宿。我还补充说，1939年4月11日上午10时左右，袁德昌（Yuen Teh Chong）的朋友赵子祥（Zau Ts Ziang，音译）（袁德昌此前曾在该酒店担任接线员）来到电话间找我，问我袁是否来过这里。我回答说他没来。与此同时，另一名不知名的中国男子进来打听袁的情况，随后他们一起离开了。此前，袁和赵曾三次来过电话间，但袁是我的老朋友，所以他经常独自来电话间。我不知道袁的住址。我也不了解他们（袁和赵）的活动。

这是我的真实供词。

袁德昌（未在押）的体貌描述。

袁德昌，年龄约22或23岁，松江或广山人，身高5英尺6英寸，面色苍白，脸型瘦长，身材瘦削，长发向后梳理，身穿西装，略懂上海话。

签名：卜宝兴

page_data.en:
further
// J. J. Fowler
.B.H. 4. (C. 1)          14.4.39              D. . I. Fung 's ing.

Regarding the letter, addressed to myself o/o how
Yah Yih (          ) at the Lung Yu per hop, Sin Ilw.
Village, Ningpo from T. Chow, w n Sung Yuan hop, Sino
du consul te, Shanghai.
As previously related in statement made by me,
I was invited by one Yuen Tuh Sung (          ) to live
with him in an attic at No. 11 Vung Yien Li, Rue Lafayette,
F.C. He moved there on about the 14th or 15th March 1939.
He had resided there for about one week (March 21st or
22nd) when Yuen Tuh Sung showed me a letter but I told him
I was unable to read. Bang Poh Ling (          ) also said
he was unable to read. Yuen Tuh Sung then read the contents
of the letter to both of us.
On the letter having been read, I noticed that the
letter had been addressed to me (I knew the characters of
my own name) and I asked Yuen Tuh Sung why he had opened
it. He replied that he had received the letter the day
before and opened it but there was no cause for worry.
I then noticed the stamp on the envelope consisted
only of the bottom half and bore no post office chop.
When I asked Yuen Tuh Sung regarding this he said the
stamp was false.
Even after the letter had been read to me I did not
understand it but thought it meant that Yuen Tuh Sung or
some friend or friends of his might be able to find me
employment (I was unemployed at the time).
During subsequent conversation between Bang Poh Ling
page_data.zh:
续
// J. J. Fowler
.B.H. 4. (C. 1)          1939年4月14日              副督察 冯士英（Fung 's ing，音译）。

关于那封信，是由上海辛元号（Sung Yuan hop，音译）的T. Chow写给宁波新屋村（Sin Ilw. Village，音译）龙裕杂货铺（Lung Yu per hop，音译）何雅义（how Yah Yih，音译）转交本人的。
正如我在之前的供词中所述，我受邀与袁笃松（Yuen Tuh Sung，音译）同住，住在法租界拉斐特路永年里11号的阁楼里。他大约在1939年3月14日或15日搬至那里。他在那里住了大约一周（3月21日或22日）时，袁笃松给我看了一封信，但我告诉他我不识字。邦伯灵（Bang Poh Ling，音译）也说他也不识字。于是袁笃松将信的内容读给我们两人听。
读完信后，我注意到信是写给我的（我认得自己名字的字），我问袁笃松为什么拆开了它。他回答说他是前一天收到信的，虽然拆开了，但无需担心。
随后我注意到信封上的邮票只有下半部分，且没有邮局邮戳。当我就此询问袁笃松时，他说邮票是假的。
即使信读给我听后，我也没听懂，但心想这意味着袁笃松或他的某个朋友能帮我找到工作（当时我失业）。
在邦伯灵随后的谈话中

page_data.en:
- 2 -

nd myself we were agreed that the contents of the letter
meant that we would both find work shortly.

I was born in ootung nd, beyond residing there
and at various addresses in Shanghai, I have never been
to other towns or cities.

I do not know why the letter should be addressed
to me in Ningpo as I have never been there neither have
I any friends there.

I do not know the writer of the letter Tsou Chien-hwa
( ) neither, to the best of my knowledge, have I
ever met him.

I have never been concerned in any other activities
therefore I do not know why I should be thanked for such
in the first part of the letter.

Signed :
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

和我之间，我们都认为信的内容意味着我们很快就能找到工作。

我出生在浦东，除了住在那里以及在上海的各个地址居住过外，我从未去过其他城镇或城市。

我不知道为什么信会寄到宁波给我，因为我从未去过那里，在那里也没有朋友。

我不认识写信人邹建华（Tsou Chien-hwa，音译），据我所知，我也从未见过他。

我从未参与过其他任何活动，因此我不明白为什么信的开头部分要为此感谢我。

签名：

page_data.en:
Unemployed, N.F.A.
Lih-yang,

BANO POH LING (  ), 23, Lih-yang, S/
D.S.I. Vung Ts Ming,
12.4.39
Yso Dinsin.

Once, some time ago, when visiting the Wing On Roof
Garden, I became acquainted with Zau Pah Sung, alias Zau Ts
Ziang, (arrested) and another, named Yuen Tuh Tsong, age about
25, at present still at large. We became very friendly with
one another afterwards.

Some time during the previous week, I happened to meet
Yuen Tuh Tsong at the entrance of the Goong Woo Lai Chinese
Theatre, Avenue Edward VII, where he informed me that he had
rented a house at 11 Vung Yien Paung, Rue Lafayette, and asked
me if I would like to accompany him to that address. I agreed
and proceeded with him to his house, where, on arrival, I saw
Zau Pah Sung also there. As we were all bosom friends, Zau
and I both stayed at Yuen's home for about 2 weeks. When we
were there, Yuen and Zau discussed with me on various topics
concerning participation in patriotic activities. When they
asked for my opinion, I told them that I had no interest in
such matters, and that I would not prove a suitable or efficient
hand in affairs of such nature. This occurred on about the
7th. April, 1939. As Zau and Yuen found that I had no
intention to take part in patriotic activities, they dropped
the matter until about the 8th. April, 1939, when in my presence
Yuen produced two revolvers and began to teach me how to use
them. At about 12:30 p.m. on the 9th. April, 1939, the three
of us engaged a room (No.411) at the Nanking Hotel, where we
resided until the morning of the 11th. April, 1939, (7 a.m.),
when Yuen handed a revolver to me and ordered me to accompany
him to a certain place where he would assassinate a traitor.
page_data.zh:
失业，无固定住所。
溧阳，

邦伯灵（BANO POH LING，音译），23岁，溧阳人，S/
副督察 冯志明（Vung Ts Ming，音译），
1939年4月12日
姚定新（Yso Dinsin，音译）。

不久前有一次，我在永安天韵楼游玩时，结识了赵柏松（Zau Pah Sung，又名赵子祥（Zau Ts Ziang），已被捕）和另一名叫袁笃宗（Yuen Tuh Tsong，音译，约25岁，目前在逃）的人。此后我们变得非常亲密。

上周的某个时候，我碰巧在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）共舞台（Goong Woo Lai Chinese Theatre）入口处遇到袁笃宗，他告诉我他在拉斐特路永年坊11号租了一所房子，并问我是否愿意陪他去那个地址。我同意了，便随他前往他的住处。到达后，我看到赵柏松也在那里。由于我们都是挚友，赵和我都在袁家住了大约两周。在那里期间，袁和赵与我讨论了各种关于参与爱国活动的话题。当他们征求我的意见时，我告诉他们对这类事情不感兴趣，而且在这种性质的事务中，我证明不了自己是个合适或得力的人手。这发生在1939年4月7日左右。由于赵和袁发现我无意参与爱国活动，他们便搁置了此事，直到1939年4月8日左右，袁当着我的面拿出两把左轮手枪，开始教我如何使用。1939年4月9日中午12时30分左右，我们三人在南京饭店开了一间房（411号），一直住到1939年4月11日早上7时，当时袁递给我一把左轮手枪，命令我陪他去某个地方，他要在那里刺杀一名汉奸。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Further, he said that my duties were to keep under observation
the watchman of the Jui Ih Lane, Lloyd Road, wherein lived the
alleged traitor. Zau Fah Sung was to accompany the mission as
well, and his duty was to stand near a book-stall at the entrance
of the alleyway and guard against any eventualities. At about
8 a.m. we left the hotel, proceeding toward our destination,
where, on arrival, I selected a spot in the alleyway and covered
the watchman therein. Zau then sat by the side of the bookstall
reading a book. At about 9:15 a.m. Yuen informed me that the
intended victim was coming, warning me to pay utmost attention
to the watchman, after which I noticed Yuen entering the lane
alone. Almost immediately afterwards, I heard two shots from
within the alleyway. At that time, I noticed the watchman coming
out from the watchman's hut, drawing his pistol and made an
attempt to shoot at me. However, before he could do so, I fired
a shot at him first. He then also fired a shot at me, the
bullet penetrating my chest. I was wounded, yet I managed to
run away through a hot-water shop near the entrance of the lane.
I then hired a ricksha and proceeded to the Dah Toong Sing Lodging
House, in French Town, where I informed my friend, Li Kying Han,
that I had been struck by stray bullets when passing along Lloyd
Road, and requested the latter to escort me back to the Nanking
Hotel. We hired 2 rickshas and soon were back in the Nanking
Hotel, where after returning the revolver to Yuen, I requested
Zau Fah Sung (who at that time had also arrived) to take me to
hospital. Zau and Li both escorted me to Paulun Hospital,
where we were arrested. Li has nothing to do with this case
at all, and so are my mother and brother. This is the truth.

Signed : BANG POH LING.

此外，他说我的任务是监视劳合路（Lloyd Road）瑞义里（Jui Ih Lane，音译）的更夫，据说那名汉奸就住在那里。赵发松（Zau Fah Sung，音译）也将陪同执行任务，他的职责是站在巷口书摊附近，防备任何意外情况。上午8时左右，我们离开酒店，前往目的地。到达后，我在巷子里选了一个位置，掩护并监视那里的更夫。赵则坐在书摊旁看书。上午9时15分左右，袁告诉我预定目标就要来了，警告我要极度注意更夫，随后我注意到袁独自进入弄堂。几乎紧接着，我听到弄堂内传来两声枪响。当时，我注意到更夫从更夫棚里出来，拔出手枪试图向我射击。然而，在他动手之前，我先向他开了一枪。随后他也向我开了一枪，子弹穿透了我的胸部。我受了伤，但还是设法通过巷口附近的一家热水店逃走了。随后我雇了一辆黄包车，前往法租界的大同兴客栈，告诉我的朋友李京汉（Li Kying Han，音译），我在经过劳合路时被流弹击中，并请他护送我回南京饭店。我们雇了两辆黄包车，很快回到了南京饭店，在将左轮手枪归还给袁之后，我请求赵发松（当时他也已到达）送我去医院。赵和李都护送我去了宝隆医院，在那里我们被捕了。李与此案毫无关系，我的母亲和兄弟也是如此。这是事实。

签名：邦伯灵（BANG POH LING）。

At 9.20 a.m. 11-4-39, a telephone message was
received at Louza Station from C.P.S.1140 reporting
that a male Chinese had been shot in Lane 139, Lloyd
Road.

D.I. Bennett and D.S.I. Black and station staff
immediately attended, enquiries ascertaining that a
male Chinese, one Doctor Shih Sze Tai (席時泰)
living at Lane 127, House No.12, Lloyd Road had been
shot dead, the body lying in the downstairs room of
premises, Lane 127, House 12, Lloyd Road, where he
resided, having been assisted by relatives to the
house after receiving bullet wounds whilst walking
in the Lane 139 subsequent to leaving his home at
9.15 a.m. 11-4-39, C.P.C. 730 also having received
injuries from a bullet wound in attempting to give
chase to an armed man, who however had been successful
in making good his escape despite two shots which
were fired at him by the C.P.C.

C.P.C. 730 immediately taken to Police Hospital
by Fire Brigade Ambulance, where he was detained,
found suffering from :-

"Bullet wound of the right arm".

Deceased male (Dr. S.T. Shih) also taken to Police
Hospital by same ambulance, certified dead upon
arrival :-

"This is to certify that I have examined the
dead body of S.T. Shih, at about 10.00 a.m.
11-4-39 and found the cause of death is due
to bullet wound of chest".

1939年4月11日上午9:20，老闸捕房接到中央捕房（C.P.S.）1140号的电话消息，报告称一名中国男子在劳合路139弄被枪击。

警探长 Bennett 和副警探长 Black 以及捕房职员立即赶赴现场，经查询查明，一名居住在劳合路127弄12号的中国男子席时泰（Shih Sze Tai）医生被枪杀，尸体躺在其居住的劳合路127弄12号房屋的楼下房间内。他在1939年4月11日上午9:15离开家后，在139弄行走时身中枪弹，随后由亲属协助抬回家中。华捕（C.P.C.）730号在试图追捕一名持枪男子时也遭枪击受伤，尽管华捕向他开了两枪，但该男子仍成功逃脱。

华捕730号随即由消防队救护车送往警察医院，并被留院观察，诊断为：

“右臂枪伤”。

男性死者（席时泰医生）也由同一辆救护车送往警察医院，抵达时被证实死亡：

“兹证明我于1939年4月11日上午10:00左右检查了席时泰（S.T. Shih）的尸体，发现死因为胸部枪伤”。

This letter (Exhibit A) was addressed to Lu Sh Sung (赵伯生) in Ningpo, purporting to have been written by one Chou (周) of the Wan Sung Yuan Shop (冠生园), who is on route (法大马路) Shanghai, and was praising their previous work at a place not mentioned and the said thing was issued as an encouragement.

Letter also contained a few extracts from the "New Life Movement" and the rumour in which traitors were of assistance to the enemy.

The letter was signed, How Hien Hua (何剑华); and ended with the expression "All the enemy and annihilate the traitor".

Assistant upon further interrogation this man, Lu To Ming, alias Lu Sh Sung admitted participation in this offence, stating that he (Lu Sh Sung) had been requested by one Oh Sing (injured man) and Tuan Chi Chang (袁德昌) (not arrested) to keep watch at the entrance to Lane 139, (Lau Xin So) (劳易里), Loyd Road in order to give warning to Ong Oh Sing (injured man) and Tuan Chi Chang (not arrested) of the approach of any police officers, for they intended to shoot a traitor.

The arrangements for this assassination were made in Room 411 of the Central Hotel during the evening of 10-4-39, and on the morning of 11-4-39 he (Lu Sh Sung) proceeded to Loyd Road and kept watch near a book stall

Translation of a Letter

Inscription on envelope:
Mr. Lau Fah-sung ( 趙伯生 ), c/o Choa Yan Yih ( 周学益 ),
Tung Lu Paper Shop, in Tan Village, Kinppo.
From Mr. [unclear], Kaan Sung Yuan Shop, Rue du
Consulate, Shanghai. 29th.

Dear Foh Lin ( 福林 )
Fah Sung ( 伯生 )
Tuh Chong ( 德昌 )

I have been well aware of your names. Your work
at x x place [unclear] admirable. Since your arrival at
x x place, I have been very anxious to see you, but circumstances
do not permit me to do so. However, I believe that in the
near future, we shall have chance to meet.

The first [unclear] made me very happy, and conse-
quently a small "thing" was issued as an encouragement.
Although the "thing" is not great it emerges from the
government that represents our hundred million citizens.
I will not tell you how we will carry out the duties which
we have been entrusted with by the people of the country.

We, in order to accomplish our duties, should be
brave, steady, enthusiastic, clever and should take exercises
to make our bodies strong.

We should lead our life in accordance with the
principles of the New Life Movement laid down by General
Chiang. The following are the brief definitions of the
4 general principles of the New Life Movement :-

1. Piety. It means that one should act politely towards
the others. So, we comrades should love each other, and
any of us when found to have acted contrary to this
principal, should be given some advice.

2. Righteousness. This principle means dutiful. As we are
people of China, we should be dutiful towards the nation.
page_data.zh:
信件译文

信封题字：
刘法松（趙伯生）先生，转交周学益（Choa Yan Yih），
江苏金浦谭村同路纸店。
发自上海领事馆路甘松源商店某先生〔原文不清〕。29日。

亲爱的福林、伯生、德昌：

久仰诸位大名。你们在某某地方〔原文不清〕的工作令人钦佩。自从你们到达某某地方以来，我一直渴望与你们见面，但 circumstances 不允许我这样做。不过，我相信在不久的将来，我们将有机会会面。

第一件〔原文不清〕事让我非常高兴，因此发放了一件小“物品”作为鼓励。虽然这件“物品”并不贵重，但它出自代表我们亿万同胞的政府。我不会告诉你们我们将如何履行人民赋予我们的职责。

为了完成我们的职责，我们应该勇敢、稳重、热情、聪明，并锻炼身体以强健体魄。

我们应该按照蒋介石将军制定的新生活运动原则来生活。以下是新生活运动四大原则的简要定义：

1. 礼。这意味着对他人的行为要有礼貌。因此，我们同志之间应该互爱，任何被发现违反这一原则的人，都应给予劝告。

2. 义。这一原则意味着尽责。作为中国人，我们应该对国家尽责。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

If we are dutiful towards the nation, our country will
be prosperous and the present enemy exterminated.
This principle may mean as faithful, consequently we
should unite and co-operate. Now, we can understand
what steps will be taken towards the traitors who are
breaking this principle and betraying their mother
country.

3. Integrity. This means that one should take what he is
entitled. Corrupt officials and traitors, who are unaware
of this principle, always attempt to satisfy their own ends
by improper means, such as defrauding the government or
betraying the country. However, we should make ourselves
thrifty and spend money in proper ways, but not to take
possession of what we are not entitled.

4. Conscientiousness. It means that one should be governed
by the dictates of conscience. The traitors are
unconscientious because they pay no attention to the fate
of the nation and their family, but aim at securing high
positions for themselves and obtaining money for their
own pockets. They sell commodities on behalf of the enemy,
who, with the money thus obtained, manufacture military
equipment and kill our people. Other unconscientious
people are as follows :- A number of opportunists, as soon
as the enemy occupy a certain place or their own native
cities, will lose confidence in the National Government and
begin to support the enemy.

There are also a large number of people who pay no
attention to the war of resistance; enjoying themselves
in dancing, gambling and other amusements. There are
others who often shout "support the war of resistance and
kill the enemy", but in reality they are not patriots but
intend to secure benefits for their own ends. The last
mentioned people should be more readily killed than others.

In conclusion, we should be loyal to the government
especially during the present war of resistance, because we
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

如果我们对国家尽责，我们的国家就会繁荣，当前的敌人就会被消灭。这一原则也可以理解为忠诚，因此我们应该团结合作。现在，我们可以理解对于那些破坏这一原则、背叛祖国的汉奸将采取什么措施。

3. 廉。这意味着一个人只应取他应得之物。贪官和汉奸不懂这一原则，总是试图通过不正当手段满足私欲，例如欺诈政府或背叛国家。然而，我们应该保持节俭，以正当方式花钱，而不占有非分之财。

4. 耻。这意味着一个人应受良心的支配。汉奸没有良心，因为他们不顾国家和家庭的命运，而是旨在为自己谋取高位并将钱财装入私囊。他们代表敌人销售商品，敌人用由此获得的资金制造军事装备并杀害我们的人民。其他没有良心的人如下：一些投机分子，一旦敌人占领某地或他们自己的家乡城市，就会对国民政府失去信心并开始支持敌人。

还有大量的人不关注抗战；沉溺于跳舞、赌博和其他娱乐活动。还有一些人经常高喊“支持抗战，杀敌”，但实际上他们并非爱国者，而是意图为一己之私谋取利益。最后提到的这些人比其他人更该死。

总之，我们应该忠于政府，特别是在当前的抗战期间，因为我们

page_data.en:
- 3 -

citizens of this country.
I write you this letter with the object of urging
you to double your efforts and improve your own life. I
understand that you have followed the "rules" and you will
soon succeed in the organization. I hope that the "rules"
will always lay before you and you will love your mother country and
support the "organization", so that we will not go beyond the
expectations of our leader General Chiang.
Kill the enemy and annihilate the traitor!

Chow Chien-hua (周劍華).
〔此处为手写签名〕
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

是这个国家的公民。
我写这封信的目的是敦促你们加倍努力，改善自己的生活。我知道你们已经遵守了“规则”，并且很快会在组织中取得成功。我希望“规则”常摆在你们面前，希望你们热爱祖国并支持“组织”，这样我们就不会辜负领袖蒋介石将军的期望。
杀敌灭奸！

周剑华。
〔此处为手写签名〕

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Zien Zse Yei (錢儀), age 28,
native of Shinkiang taken by me // D.I. Loh Kung Sung
at Louza Station on the 11-4-39 and translated Clark Sit Yun Pai.
and interpreted by

I reside in a barber shop in Siau Lo Ko of Tuhu Rd.
I am a chauffeur, driving m/car No.3147, my employer being
one Shih Sz Tai, a doctor, also the Secretary to Loo Ying,
the Commissioner of the new Shanghai City Government Police.

On 26-1-39, I was introduced by my former employer
Loh Sun, to Shih Sz Tai as his chauffeur.

Daily at 9.a.m. I took Shih Sz Tai in the car, No.
3147, to the new Shanghai City Government and returned home
at about 6.p.m. Shih Sz Tai would not use the car again when
he arrived at home. Every day I attended my employer's home,
No.12 Chu Yi Lee off Lloyd Road, Sundays excluded. There was
no garage for the m/car, so it was left in the alleyway when
not in use.

This morning at about 7.a.m. (11-4-39), as usual, I
attended Shih's home and after having partaken of my breakfast,
I drove the car from the alleyway to the roadway, Lloyd Road.
Then I returned to the kitchen of the house, waiting for my
employer.

At about 9.20 a.m. 11-4-39, Shih Sz Tai left his
home by the rear door. As stated above I ranked the car
outside the lane on Lloyd Road this time, but sometime on
my employer's instructions I would park the car on Yu Ya
Ching Road, outside No.564 - a hot water shop, then access
would be gained through the back door of the hot water shop
facing Yu Ya Ching Road, in order to get the car. No such
instructions were given by my employer to-day.

Seeing Shih Sz Tai ready for going out, I at once
page_data.zh:

G (14M 1-39

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

警务调查报告。

以下是钱仪（Zien Zse Yei），28岁，江苏籍，由督察罗公颂（Loh Kung Sung）于1939年4月11日在老闸捕房录取，并由职员席云佩（Clark Sit Yun Pai）翻译的口供。

我住在杜赫路（Tuhu Rd.）小罗阁的一家理发店里。
我是一名司机，驾驶第3147号机动车，我的雇主是施士泰（Shih Sz Tai）医生，他也是新上海市政府警察局局长陆英（Loo Ying）的秘书。

1939年1月26日，经我前雇主罗孙（Loh Sun）介绍，我成为施士泰的司机。

每天早上9点，我驾驶3147号车送施士泰去新上海市政府，大约在下午6点回家。施士泰到家后不再使用该车。每天我都去雇主家，地址是劳合路（Lloyd Road）朱衣里12号，星期日除外。由于没有车库，机动车在不使用时就停在弄堂里。

今天早上大约7点（1939年4月11日），像往常一样，我来到施家，吃完早餐后，我将车从弄堂开到劳合路的大路上。然后我回到房子的厨房，等待我的雇主。

1939年4月11日上午9点20分左右，施士泰从后门离开家。如上所述，这次我将车停在劳合路弄堂口，但有时根据雇主的指示，我会将车停在虞洽卿路564号——一家热水店外面，然后通过面向虞洽卿路的热水店后门进入以取车。但今天雇主没有给出这样的指示。

看到施士泰准备出门，我立刻

walked to the car parked at the entrance to the alleyway,
and was opening the door of the car, when suddenly I heard
the sound of two gun shots being fired in the alleyway. I
immediately turned round and saw my employer Shih Sz Wei
bending his body and walking in a staggered manner. By this
time some body behind me struck on my right arm once and used
abusive language against me, speaking in Shantung dialect.
This man said, to which direction I should run. Turning round
I found him to be a youth, age about 20 years, height about
5'3/4", wearing a coffee coloured long gown. Being afraid
to talk with him, I ran away along Lloyd Road, North to Chefoo,
Kweichow and Peking Road, East to Chekiang and Nankin Roads,
where I boarded a Route No.2 tramcar to Gordon Road and after
alighting from the car I went to the home of my former employer,
Loh Sun and informed him of the above occurrence. Driving
Loh's car we both returned to Shih's home, 12 Chu Yi Lee,
Lloyd Road.

True statement.

Signed and cross-marked: Tien Ze Fei.

走到停在弄堂口的车旁，正打开车门时，突然听到弄堂里传来两声枪响。我立即转身，看到我的雇主施士伟（Shih Sz Wei）弯着腰，步履蹒跚地走着。这时，我身后有人打了一下我的右臂，并用山东方言骂我。这个人问我该往哪个方向跑。我转身发现他是一个年轻人，大约20岁，身高约5英尺3/4英寸，穿着一件咖啡色的长袍。因为害怕和他说话，我沿着劳合路向北跑到芝罘路、贵州路和北京路，向东跑到浙江路和南京路，在那里我乘上了2路电车到戈登路，下车后我去了我前雇主罗孙的家，告诉他上述发生的事。开着罗的车，我们俩回到了施位于劳合路朱衣里12号的家。

口供属实。

签字并画押：田泽飞（Tien Ze Fei）。

page_data.en:
FORM 40
G. 44M 1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Soong Kiang Yoon (宋江荣), age 47,
native of Shantung taken by D.I. Loh Kung Sung
at Louza Stn. on the 11-4-30 and translated by Clerk Sih Yun Pei.

I am employed as a Police watchman No. 277, being
on duty at Lane 136 (Chu Yi Lee) off Lloyd Road. I have
been on this job for the past 12 years.
To-day (11-4-30) I would be on 1st day duty - from
7.a.m. to 7.p.m., the night duty watchman being Watchman No.
485, from 7.p.m. to 7.a.m. the next morning.
At about 9.a.m. this morning, I saw C.P.C.730 on
patrol duty, passing the entrance of the alleyway, whereupon
I invited him to enter the alleyway in order to have a cup of
tea. He (C.P.C.730) entered the alleyway and took a seat
in my wooden hut. We sat together, on a wooden stool, he
sitting at the West end, while I at the East, both facing
North. We sat upon the stool for about 10 minutes, when
I saw a man dressed in blue cloth jacket and pants entering
the alleyway towards the West. I did not pay much attention
to him. Unexpectedly by this time another man wearing a
dark grey short jacket put his appearance at the door of the
watchman's hut and producing a pistol warned me not to move.
Simultaneously he opened shots at C.P.C.730 who was sitting
at the West end (about two shots). C.P.C.730 also drew out
his pistol, opening about three shots, though he was sitting.
The offender then ran away towards the West, bending his body
when decamping. Leaving the hut I proceeded to the mouth
of the alleyway and blew Police whistle, as I was not armed.
At the same time, C.P.C.730 gave chase to the running person.
Being much frightened at the time, I was not able to recall
the full description of the absconded man.
page_data.zh:

G. 44M 1-39

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

警务调查报告。

以下是宋江荣（Soong Kiang Yoon），47岁，山东籍，由督察罗公颂（Loh Kung Sung）于1930年4月11日〔注：原文年份疑似OCR错误，结合上下文应为1939年〕在老闸捕房录取，并由职员席云佩（Sih Yun Pei）翻译的口供。

我受雇为第277号警备员，在劳合路朱衣里136弄执勤。我从事这项工作已有12年。
今天（1930年4月11日）我值白班——从上午7点到下午7点，夜班警备员是第485号，从下午7点到次日早上7点。
今天上午大约9点，我看到巡捕C.P.C.730在巡逻，经过弄堂口，于是我邀请他进弄堂喝杯茶。他（C.P.C.730）走进弄堂，在我的木棚里坐下。我们一起坐在一张木凳上，他坐在西头，我坐在东头，都面朝北。我们在凳子上坐了大约10分钟，这时我看到一个穿着蓝布夹克和裤子的人向西走进弄堂。我没有太注意他。没想到这时另一个穿着深灰色短夹克的男人出现在警备员棚门口，掏出手枪警告我不许动。同时，他向坐在西头的C.P.C.730开枪（大约两枪）。C.P.C.730也拔出手枪，虽然坐着，但也开了大约三枪。罪犯随后向西逃跑，逃跑时弯着腰。我离开棚子，走到弄堂口吹警哨，因为我没带武器。与此同时，C.P.C.730追赶那个逃跑的人。当时我非常害怕，无法回忆起逃跑者的完整外貌特征。

While I was blowing whistle at the entrance of
the alley way, I was able to see Mr. Shih Sz Tai, resident
of house 12, lying in the alley-way, apparently having been
shot.

Prior to my being threatened by the aforesaid man
with his pistol, I heard one shot being fired in the alleyway.
I thought that the assassin who had opened shots at
the U.P.U. must have been wounded at the time when shots
exchanged, because he was bending when decamping.

Later I reported the occurrence to the Station by
using the telephone installed at house 12 of this alleyway.

Signed and cross-marked:
Soong Kiang Yoong.

以下是宋江荣的口供。
____籍，由____于____在____录取，并由____翻译

当我在弄堂口吹哨子时，我能看到住在12号的施士泰先生躺在弄堂里，显然是中枪了。

在上述男子用手枪威胁我之前，我听到弄堂里响了一声枪。我想那个向U.P.U.〔原文不清，可能指巡捕或特定人员〕开枪的刺客在交火时一定受了伤，因为他逃跑时弯着腰。

后来，我用安装在弄堂12号的电话向捕房报告了此事。

签字并画押：
宋江荣。

The following is the statement of ____ C.P.S. 730, Zau Moch Len (赵玉岚), No. 49,
native of ____ Liang Hsi ____, taken by Mr. S. W. L. 7 Lin, In Chung,
at Hospital ____ on the 11-4-39 ____ and translated by Clerk Sih Yun Pai.

I beg to report the following:

I reported for duty at 7 a.m. on 11-4-39, being
detailed patrolling Sect. 1 Beat 4.

At 9.10 a.m. 11-4-39, while passing Lane 139 Lloyd
Road, I was invited by C.P.S. 277 who was on duty in the
alleyway, to have a cup of tea at his hut. I sat down in
the watchman's hut for just about one minute, when I heard
the sound of likely gun shot being fired in the alleyway.
Simultaneously a man age about 20, slim build, long thin
face, wearing a grey felt hat and an unknown coloured long
gown, of sudden appearance at the door of the hut, and
producing a pistol spoke in common Chinese "not to move".
He opened one shot at my right shoulder, whereupon I at once
drew out my pistol, and one shot at his stomach. This
man immediately ran away, holding his stomach with two hands.
I again fired two further shots at his back, when he was
running across the lane into a back door of house
No. 51 Lane 139, and came out through this
house, and escaped towards Yu Ching Road. I gave
chase but due to injuries received I could not effect his
arrest. Later C.P.S. 277 blew police whistle, being responded
to by C.P.S. 1400 who attended the scene. I handed to
this C.P.S. my pistol, and at the same time I was aware that
a male Chinese had been wounded in the alleyway.

(Signed)
Signed and cross-marked:
Zau Moch Len (C.P.S. 730)

以下是巡捕C.P.S. 730，赵玉岚（Zau Moch Len），编号49，____梁溪____籍，由林仁忠（S. W. L. 7 Lin, In Chung）先生于1939年4月11日在医院____录取，并由职员席云佩（Sih Yun Pai）翻译的口供。

谨报告如下：

我于1939年4月11日上午7点报到上班，被派往第1区第4段巡逻。

1939年4月11日上午9点10分，当我经过劳合路139弄时，正在弄堂里执勤的C.P.S. 277邀请我去他的棚里喝杯茶。我在警备员棚里坐了大约一分钟，这时听到弄堂里传来像是枪声的声音。同时，一个大约20岁、身材瘦削、长瘦脸、戴着灰色毡帽、穿着颜色不明的长袍的男人突然出现在棚门口，掏出手枪用普通话说“不许动”。他朝我的右肩开了一枪，于是我立即拔出手枪，朝他的腹部开了一枪。这个人立刻双手捂着肚子逃跑了。当他跑过弄堂进入139弄51号的后门时，我又朝他的背部开了两枪，他从这所房子出来，向虞洽卿路方向逃去。我进行了追赶，但由于受伤，未能将其逮捕。后来C.P.S. 277吹响了警哨，C.P.S. 1400响应并赶到现场。我将手枪交给这位巡捕，同时我意识到有一名中国男子在弄堂里受伤。

（签名）
签字并画押：
赵玉岚（C.P.S. 730）

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Hsia Kwang Sun (夏廣勝), a.g. 48,
native of Yau Chow, taken by Det. Sgt. Sun Sun,
translated
at Louza Stn. on the 11-4-40 and interpreted by Clerk Sik Yun Pai.

I reside in an unnumbered country style house at
Zau Za Yoo. I am a coolie employed in the Chu Yi Lee off
Lloyd Road, and my work is to wash and clean 5 Private
Motorcars, Licenses Nos. 3154, 8468, 9142, the other two
numbers forgotten, belonging to various residents of the
alleyway. I have been on this job for the past three years.

This morning at about 7.a.m. I left my home and
proceeded to the above alleyway for the purpose of performing
my daily work. I completed washing four of the cars, and
at about 9.a.m. while I was washing the remaining one on
the East side of Lloyd Road, I suddenly heard the sound of
4 or 5 gun shots being fired. I immediately stood up in
order to see what had happened, when I saw a S.P.C. in Chu
Yi Lee (Lane 129 Lloyd Road) drawing out his pistol chasing
a man dressed in a dark purple coloured long gown who was
running ahead 5-7 in the alleyway. This man bent his head,
placing both hands at his breast when decamping. The dis-
tance between the running person and the S.P.C. was approx.
12 yards. This alleyway is a cul-de-sac, but access could
be gained through back doors of houses onto Yu Ya Ching Road.
Therefore, for the purpose of convenience, residents in this
alleyway usually gain entrance by the back door onto Yu Ya
Ching Road. Later I found Mr. Shih Tai of House No. 12 in
this lane lying in the alleyway, having been shot down by
some person. The S.P.C. received bullet wounds at his right
arm. Later Police officers attended the scene, and I know
nothing further.

（签名）
Signed & cross-marked:
Hsia Kwang Sun.

警务调查报告。
（手写：4）

以下为夏廣勝（Hsia Kwang Sun），48岁，扬州人，于1940年4月11日在老闸捕房由警长孙孙（Sun Sun，音译）录取、由职员白锡云（Sik Yun Pai，音译）翻译的口供。

我居住在乍浦路一处无门牌号的乡间式房屋内。我是劳合路（Lloyd Road）外“朱义里”（Chu Yi Lee，音译）的一名苦力，我的工作是为巷内不同住户拥有的5辆私人汽车进行清洗和清洁，车牌号分别为3154、8468、9142，另外两个号码已遗忘。我从事这份工作已有三年。

今天早上约7点，我离开家，前往上述巷弄进行日常工作。我洗完了其中四辆车，上午9点左右，当我正在劳合路东侧清洗剩下的一辆车时，突然听到4或5声枪响。我立即站起来查看发生了什么事，这时我看到一名便衣警察（S.P.C.）在朱义里（劳合路129弄）拔出手枪，追赶一名身穿深紫色长衫的男子，该男子在巷弄中向前跑了5-7码。这名男子逃跑时低着头，双手护在胸前。奔跑者与便衣警察之间的距离约为12码。这条巷弄是死胡同，但可以通过房屋的后门进入虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）。因此，为了方便起见，该巷弄的居民通常通过后门进入虞洽卿路。后来我发现该弄12号的施泰（Shih Tai，音译）先生躺在巷弄里，被某人枪击倒地。该名便衣警察右臂中弹。随后警官抵达现场，此后我便一无所知了。

（签名）
签名并画十字标记：
夏廣勝。

The following is the statement of Zau Ts Ziang (趙志祥) alias Zau Pah Sung (趙伯生)
native of Pootung taken by me D.I. Loh Kung-sung
at Louza Stn on the 11/4/39 and translated / interpreted by Clerk Jong Chia-tsing.

My name is Zau Ts Ziang (趙志祥) or Zau Pah-sung (趙伯生). I am a native of Dong Jau (塘桥), Pootung, age 28. From the age of 13, I became an apprentice in a foreign ladies tailoring shop named Yih Oong Kee (葉洪记) at the corner of Avenue Joffre and Rue Pere Robert, and remained there for five years. At the age of 19, I entered the Hwa Dah Foreign Dress Shop, Foochow Road, as a shop assistant, and later joined the Hwa Tsang Foreign Dress Shop.

Before the outbreak of the hostilities when I was twentyone years old, I resigned from the shop in the summer season owing to business depression, and returned to my native place in Pootung and lived with my brother named Chao Ling Keng (趙林根) who is a boatman by profession. He operates his boat at, the Tung. Ka Doo Wharf.

At the age of 21, I was married to the daughter of one Chang at Lan Chi Kan Village, east of Dong Jau, Pootung. I have no child. My wife has returned to her mother's home, when I became unemployed.

In January last year, I was engaged as a coolie in the Lao Kung Mow Shipbuilding Yard, Pah Lien Ching, Pootung (Japanese). I obtained this post through the recommendation of my friend, and I was placed under the supervision of foreman Nyi Moh Sung (倪木生). Owing to lack of business, I again became unemployed in May, when I returned to live in my own home at Dong Jau, Pootung. I was sometimes called upon to do casual tailoring work

以下为趙志祥（Zau Ts Ziang），又名趙伯生（Zau Pah Sung），浦东人，于1939年4月11日在老闸捕房由我，侦探督察罗公松（Loh Kung-sung，音译）录取，并由职员钟家清（Jong Chia-tsing，音译）翻译/口译的口供。

我叫趙志祥或趙伯生。我是浦东塘桥（Dong Jau）人，现年28岁。从13岁起，我在霞飞路与神父罗伯特路（Rue Pere Robert）转角处一家名为“葉洪记”（Yih Oong Kee）的外国女装裁缝店当学徒，在那里待了五年。19岁时，我进入福州路的“华达”（Hwa Dah，音译）洋服店担任店员，后来又加入了“华昌”（Hwa Tsang，音译）洋服店。

在战事爆发前，我二十一岁那年，夏季因生意萧条从店里辞职，回到浦东老家，与以划船为业的哥哥趙林根（Chao Ling Keng）同住。他在董家渡码头（Tung. Ka Doo Wharf）经营船只。

21岁时，我与浦东塘桥以东兰旗杆村（Lan Chi Kan Village，音译）张家的女儿结婚。我没有孩子。在我失业后，妻子回到了娘家。

去年一月，我在浦东八仙桥（Pah Lien Ching，音译）的“老公茂”造船厂（日本）受雇为苦力。我是通过朋友推荐得到这份工作的，并在工头倪木生（Nyi Moh Sung）的监督下工作。由于缺乏业务，我在五月再次失业，随后回到浦东塘桥的自家居住。有时我会应一些朋友之邀做零星的裁缝工作

by some of my friends.
On the 15th of the 1st moon (lunar calendar)
i.e. March 5, 1939, I came to Shanghai with the object of
finding employment, and took up residence temporary at
the home of my brother-in-law, Tsu Ling Keng (朱林根);
on an attic in Ching Loong Zung Rice Shop, in Tsai Sz Loong,
Ferry Road. I stayed there for about three days.
At that time I made the following recollection:-
When I was employed before the outbreak of the hostilities,
I and three or five colleagues often booked room in the Dah
Tung Sing Lodging House, Rue Palikao, to play mah-jong.
One day, one of my friend introduced me to a waiter of the
lodging house named Bang Feh-ling (who is the injured man
now detained in the Paulun Hospital). I then became on
intimate terms with Bang. When I was unemployed, I made
acquaintance with a section chief of the guerillas in Pootung,
named Chang, full name unknown. He is generally known as
Sectional Chief Chang. While Chang is stationed at Pah
Tsa Village, Pootung, he introduced me to one named Yuan
Tuh-chong (袁得昌 or 袁德昌), nativity unknown. Unexpectedly
three months ago
Sectional Chief Chang surrendered to the Japanese, and
therefore I came to Shanghai.
As I had failed to obtain any employment since my
arrival in Shanghai, I remembered Yuan Tuh-chong, whom I knew
often booked room in the Great Shanghai Hotel or Nanking
Hotel. Consequently I went to the Great Shanghai Hotel
and asked the telephone operator, name unknown, whether

由我的一些朋友介绍。
在农历正月十五，即1939年3月5日，我来到上海寻找工作，暂时寄居在我姐夫朱林根（Tsu Ling Keng）家中；地点在斐伦路（Ferry Road）蔡兴隆（Tsai Sz Loong，音译）的“庆隆涌”米行阁楼。我在那里住了大约三天。
当时我有如下回忆：
在战事爆发前受雇期间，我和三五个同事经常在贝勒路（Rue Palikao）的“大东兴”旅馆（Dah Tung Sing Lodging House，音译）包房间打麻将。有一天，我的一位朋友把我介绍给旅馆的一名侍者，名叫邦费林（Bang Feh-ling，音译，即目前拘押在宝隆医院的伤者）。随后我与邦变得关系亲密。在我失业期间，我结识了浦东游击队的一位区队长，姓张，全名不详。他通常被称为张区队长。当张驻扎在浦东八灶村（Pah Tsa Village，音译）时，他把我介绍给一个叫袁得昌（Yuan Tuh-chong，原文注：袁得昌或袁德昌）的人，籍贯不详。没想到三个月前
张区队长向日本人投降，因此我来到了上海。
自到达上海以来，我一直未能找到工作，我想起了袁得昌，我知道他经常在大上海酒店或南京饭店包房间。于是我去大上海酒店，询问一位姓名不详的电话接线员，袁是否

Yuan had been there. He replied in the negative and told
to enquire at the Nanking Hotel. I therefore proceeded to
the latter hotel and went into the Telephone Operators Room,
where I met Yuan Tuh-chong who was just there. Yuan and
I then left the hotel and came to the roadway (in front of
the Nanking Hotel, Shanse Road), when I asked him whether
he could fine me some employment. Yuan accompanied me to
the tram stopping place near the Great World Amusement
Resort. We waited there until 5 p.m. when a certain person
appeared and Yuan introduced me to that man, stating that
I had to remember the appearance of the man but not to
ask him about his name. Consequently, I did not say anythin
Soon afterwards we dispersed, when Yuan told me to again
wait for him in front of the Great World Amusement Resort
at 2 p.m. January 24th of the 1st moon (March 14). On
that day, March 14, I proceeded to the front of the Great
World Amusement Resort at 2 p.m. and waited there. About
half an hour later, Yuan came and accompanied me to No.11
Vung Yien Li (文贤里), Rue Lafayette, where we rented an
attic at $22 a month. Yuan paid the rent and brought to
the newly rented room furnitures. The cotton quilts
are belonging to me. On that day, Yuan, I and Bang Foh
Ling (who was invited by Yuan) slept there. Our daily
food was purchased by Yuan Tuh-chong. Later I had my wife
called to Shanghai and resided with me for about one
week, when she again returned to her native home.

去过那里。他回答没有，并让我去南京饭店打听。于是我前往后者，进入电话接线员室，在那里遇到了正好在那里的袁得昌。随后我和袁离开酒店，来到马路上（南京饭店前的山西路），我问他能否帮我找份工作。袁陪我到大世界游乐场附近的电车站。我们在那里等到下午5点，这时出现了一个人，袁把我介绍给那个人，说我要记住这个人的相貌，但不要问他的名字。因此，我什么也没说。
不久后我们分散，袁让我在农历正月二十四（3月14日）下午2点再次在大世界游乐场前等他。那天，3月14日，我于下午2点来到大世界游乐场前等待。大约半小时后，袁来了，陪我去霞飞路文贤里11号，我们在那里以每月22元的价格租了一间阁楼。袁支付了租金，并把家具搬进了新租的房间。棉被是我的。那天，袁、我和邦福林（Bang Foh Ling，音译，由袁邀请）睡在那里。我们的日常食物由袁得昌购买。后来我把妻子叫到上海，和我住了大约一周，之后她又回到了老家。

At about __p.m. on the 6-4-39, Yuan gave me 20 cents, asking me to go out and buy some food. I bought some food and returned home and on opening room door, I observed that both Yuan and Sang were each cleaning a revolver and a pistol respectively. They then instructed me to keep silent about the pistols. We partook of our food in the room.

At about __p.m. on the 9-4-39, accompanied by Yuan and Sang, I proceeded to Nanjing Hotel, where room No. 411 was booked. They asked me to remain in the room, but they themselves left and returned to the room very often.

At about 10.p.m. yesterday (10-4-39) Yuan and Sang returned to the room, Yuan stating that we all would go to Lloyd Road to shoot a traitor on the morning of the following day. Yuan asked me to keep on guard under the pretext of reading books at a book stall on Lloyd Road, to quickly pass information re the approach of police officers, when carrying out this work.

In the morning of 11-4-39, Yuan gave me 10 cents, and at about 8.a.m. as instructed, I proceeded to Lloyd Road, and saw a book stall located at the North side of Chu Yi Lo alleyway. I went to the stall and paying 4 coppers to the hawker, rented 4 books. Then I sat down nearby the stall, reading the books. About 45 minutes later, Yuan and Sang came to the entrance of Chu Yih Lee alleyway, situated at South side of the book stall, about 3 shops' distance. Suddenly I heard the reports of two gun shots, and these

1939年4月6日下午约 __ 点，袁给了我20分钱，让我出去买些食物。我买了食物回家，打开房门时，看到袁和桑（Sang，音译）各自在擦拭一把左轮手枪和一把手枪。随后他们指示我对枪支一事保持沉默。我们在房间里吃了饭。

1939年4月9日下午约 __ 点，在袁和桑的陪同下，我前往南京饭店，预订了411号房间。他们让我留在房间里，但他们自己经常离开又返回房间。

昨天（1939年4月10日）晚上10点左右，袁和桑回到房间，袁说我们第二天早上都要去劳合路枪杀一名汉奸。袁让我在劳合路的一个书摊旁假装看书放哨，以便在执行这项任务时，迅速传递有关警察 approaching（接近）的信息。

1939年4月11日早上，袁给了我10分钱，按照指示，我在上午8点左右前往劳合路，看到一个位于朱义里（Chu Yi Lo，音译）巷北侧的书摊。我走到摊位前，付给小贩4个铜板，租了4本书。然后我坐在摊位附近看书。大约45分钟后，袁和桑来到朱义里巷口，位于书摊南侧，相距约3家店铺的距离。突然我听到两声枪响，这两

two persons at t.. time disappeared. I returned back to

Bang's brother who stated himself to be named Bang ..ing

以下为 ____ 的口供，____ 籍人，由我 ____ 于 ____ 在 ____ 录取，并由 ____ 翻译

个人当时消失了。我回到银行饭店（Banking Hotel，音译，此处可能指南京饭店或其他，原文如此），站在电话接线员室的入口处。大约5分钟后，我看到邦友林（Bang You Ling，音译，即前述邦费林/邦福林）由他的兄弟搀扶着走向酒店。我问电话室里的人袁得昌是否回来了，回答是“没有”。然后我问邦友林出了什么事，他的兄弟回答说，他（邦友林）中了枪伤。我们没有坐电梯，三人走下楼。在行走时我没有搀扶邦友林，因为我担心这会引起怀疑。走到门口，我雇了三辆公共黄包车，护送邦友林去宝隆医院（Laulun Hospital，音译），每辆黄包车费20分。
到达医院约15分钟后，中外侦探来到医院，并将我带到捕房，但邦的兄弟不见了。
邦的兄弟在医院自称名叫邦..华（Bang ..ing Hua，原文不清），我曾有一次在法租界某处见过他。
侦探曾搜查过我的住所。

签名，Au Ts'iang（按拇指印）

page_data.en:
Shun Pao and other local newspapers (April 12) :-

CHIEF SECRETARY OF THE CITY GOVERNMENT POLICE BUREAU
MURDERED

On the morning of April 11, Hsi Shih-tei (席時泰),
Chief Secretary of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City
Government, was murdered on Lloyd Road.
Hsi Shih-tai, native of Kiangsu, age 49,
residing at No. 12 Ch'i Yih Li (居易里), Lloyd Road, was
a returned student from Japan. Upon his return to China,
he practised as a physician and established the Shih Tai
Hospital (時泰醫院). He was married but had two
concubines, one of whom is a Japanese. He has two sons
and three daughters.
After the withdrawal of the Chinese forces
from Shanghai, Hsi became Chief Secretary of the Police
Bureau of the Shanghai City Government. He was the
possessor of a new motor car bearing licence No. 3172.
His elder son named Hsi Yuin-tse (席行慈) is Chief of a
certain radio broadcasting station established by a
certain party and is engaged in spreading "strange" reports.
At 9.15 a.m. yesterday, Hsi Shih-tai left
his residence at No. 12 Ch'i Yih Li, Lloyd Road, by the
back door. When he had gone a few steps, two sturdy
Chinese, one in a long gown and the other in short clothing,
approached with Mauser pistols and one of them shot Hsi
in the head and breast, while the other kept a watch on
Soong Kieng-yung (宋景榮), a watchman in the alleyway,
No. 177. Hsi fell to the ground.
At this time, C.P.C. 73C attached to Louza
Police Station happened to pass by and heard the pistol
reports. He entered the alleyway and raised an alarm.
Upon seeing the policeman, the gunmen opened fire and an
exchange of 5 or 6 shots took place. The policeman was
struck in the breast and fell to the ground, whereupon
the gunmen ran out of the alleyway and made good their
escape.
Upon receipt of a report, detectives and
policemen of Louza Police Station arrived on the scene
and removed Hsi Shih-tai and the wounded policeman to
the Police Hospital, but the former succumbed to his wounds
on the way.
During the exchange of shots, a pedestrian
named Bang Foh-ling (彭福林), native of Liyang (溧陽),
Kiangsu, age 23, was hit by a stray bullet which penetrated
his chest. He was removed to the Paulun Hospital for
treatment. The Police sent two policemen to the hospital
to keep a watch on him. It is learned that Bang lives
at No. 11, Wen Yien Li (文賢里), Rue Lafayette, French
Concession. Up to a late hour last night, he was still
in a very serious condition.
On the afternoon of April 11, many officers
of a certain party called at the Paulun Hospital to make
discreet enquiries.
According to a report issued by the Domei
News Agency, Hsi Shih-tai was attached to the Japanese
Military Publicity Department. He undertook important
missions on behalf of Japan's cultural enterprises in
China. For this reason, the Japanese military authorities
are paying great attention to his assassination.
page_data.zh:
《申报》及其他本地报纸（4月12日）：-

市政府警察局局长秘书被杀

4月11日上午，上海市政府警察局局长秘书席时泰（Hsi Shih-tei，音译：席时泰）在劳合路（Lloyd Road）被杀。
席时泰，江苏人，49岁，居住在劳合路居易里12号，是一名留日归国学生。回国后，他行医并创办了时泰医院。他已婚，但纳有两妾，其中一人为日本人。他有两个儿子和三个女儿。
在中国军队撤离上海后，席出任上海市政府警察局局长秘书。他拥有一辆新车牌号为3172的新汽车。他的长子席行慈（Hsi Yuin-tse，音译）是某党派设立的某广播电台台长，从事散布“奇异”消息的活动。
昨天上午9点15分，席时泰从劳合路居易里12号的后门离开住所。刚走几步，两名体格健壮的中国男子，一人穿长袍，另一人穿短装，手持毛瑟手枪逼近，其中一人向席的头部和胸部开枪，另一人则监视弄堂177号的更夫宋景荣（Soong Kieng-yung，音译）。席倒地。
此时，隶属老闸捕房的华籍巡捕73C号恰好路过，听到枪声。他进入弄堂并发出警报。枪手见到警察后开火，双方互射五六枪。警察胸部中弹倒地，随后枪手跑出弄堂成功逃脱。
接到报告后，老闸捕房的侦探和警察赶到现场，将席时泰和受伤警察送往警务处医院，但前者在途中因伤重不治身亡。
在交火期间，一名名叫彭福林（Bang Foh-ling，音译）的行人，江苏溧阳人，23岁，被流弹击中胸部。他被送往宝隆医院接受治疗。警方派了两名警察到医院看守他。据悉，彭住在法租界霞飞路文贤里11号。直到昨晚深夜，他的情况仍然非常危急。
4月11日下午，某党派的许多官员前往宝隆医院进行秘密探询。
据同盟通讯社发布的报道，席时泰隶属于日本军方宣传部。他代表日本在华文化事业执行重要任务。因此，日本军方当局对他的遇刺极为关注。

page_data.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following report on April 12, 1939 :-

ASSASSINATION OF HSI SHIH-TAI, A MEMBER OF THE JAPANESE
MILITARY PRESS SECTION : ONE ASSAILANT ESCAPES, THE OTHER
SERIOUSLY WOUNDED

Hsi Shih-tai, Chief Secretary of the Police
Bureau of the Shanghai City Government and concurrently a
special member of the Japanese Military Press Section, resides
in Chu Yee Li (居易里) off Lloyd Road. At about 9 a.m.
April 11, while he was walking past House 6 of the same alley-
way on his way to office, he was fired at from behind by two
assailants and wounded in the left ear, chest and abdomen and
collapsed to the ground. The two culprits, upon seeing that
their mission had been achieved, started to flee when C.P.C.
730 attached to Louza Police Station, who had witnessed the
tragedy, gallantly gave chase and opened fire at the assailants
who returned the fire wounding the officer in the right shoulder.
One of the assailants made good his escape, but the other was
seriously wounded in the abdomen.

Hsi Shih-tai was afterwards removed by his
family to the S.M.C. hospital, but he succumbed to his injuries
before medical treatment could be administered to him.
Commissioner Loo of the Police Bureau greatly regretted the
death of Hsi Shih-tai and immediately appointed a committee
to attend to the funeral arrangements.

The Shanghai City Government, upon receipt of
a report of the incident, has lodged a strong verbal protest
with Mr. Franklin, Chairman of the S.M.C.

《新顺报》（日本人拥有的中文报纸）于1939年4月12日刊登了以下报道：-

日本军方报道部成员席时泰遇刺：一名袭击者逃脱，另一名受重伤

上海市政府警察局局长秘书兼日本军方报道部特约成员席时泰，居住在劳合路旁的居易里。4月11日上午9时许，他在前往办公室途中，行至该弄堂6号附近时，被两名袭击者从背后开枪射击，左耳、胸部和腹部受伤，倒在地上。两名罪犯见目的已达，开始逃跑，目睹惨剧的老闸捕房华籍巡捕730号英勇追赶并向袭击者开火，袭击者还击，致使该警员右肩受伤。其中一名袭击者成功逃脱，但另一名腹部受重伤。

席时泰随后被其家人送往工部局医院，但在接受救治前因伤重不治身亡。
警察局局长鲁专员对席时泰之死深表遗憾，并立即任命一个委员会负责丧葬事宜。

上海市政府在收到事件报告后，已向工部局董事会主席富兰克林先生提出强烈的口头抗议。

April 12, 1939.
(Chinese language newspaper)
Sin Shun Pao (Japan- editorial :-
Publishes the
CRITICISM OF SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES

On April 11 a case of assassination occurred
in the International Settlement in which Hsi Shih-tai (席時泰)
was unfortunately attacked and fatally shot. This is the
first case of assassination since the adoption by the Settlement
authorities of precautionary measures against terroristic
groups, and it is for this reason that this act of terrorism
deserves special attention.

In the first place, this resumption of activities
by Kuomintang terroristic elements is attributable to the
inadequate police precautions adopted by the Settlement
authorities. Take, for instance, the locality where Hsi
Shih-tai was murdered. It is on Lloyd Road in the central
district of the International Settlement. Furthermore, the
murder took place in broad daylight, yet the assailants
succeeded in making good their escape after the incident.
The Settlement authorities cannot explain away their
responsibility for inefficient police work. The affair
provides ample proof that the various precautionary measures
adopted by the Settlement authorities in the past are merely
for show purposes and constitute a half-hearted effort to
fulfil their obligations!

Secondly, the repeated lukewarm efforts on
the part of the Settlement authorities in the maintenance
of peace and good order have given rise to renewed acts of
terrorism. We say with emphasis that the Settlement
authorities are really insincere in their work for the
suppression of the terroristic groups hiding in the Settlement;

（批：Jcs.B.）
（批：P.A to B.C. (So. Br) 13/4.）
page_data.zh:
1939年4月12日。
（中文报纸）
《新顺报》（日本- 社论：-
刊登
批评租界当局

4月11日，国际租界发生了一起暗杀案，席时泰（席时泰）不幸遭到袭击并被枪杀身亡。这是租界当局采取针对恐怖团体的预防措施以来的第一起暗杀案，正因如此，这一恐怖行为值得特别关注。

首先，国民党恐怖分子活动的恢复，归咎于租界当局采取的警力预防措施不足。以席时泰被杀的地点为例。它位于国际租界中心区的劳合路。此外，谋杀发生在光天化日之下，然而袭击者在事后成功逃脱。租界当局无法推卸其警务工作不力的责任。此事充分证明，租界当局过去采取的各种预防措施 merely 是做样子，构成了履行其义务的半心半意的努力！

其次，租界当局在维持和平与秩序方面反复表现出的冷淡努力，导致了恐怖行为的再次发生。我们要强调指出，租界当局在镇压隐藏在租界内的恐怖团体方面确实缺乏诚意；

（批注：Jcs.B.）
（批注：P.A 致 B.C. (南处) 4月13日。）

page_data.en:
- 2 -

in other words, they have failed to accept with sincerity
the requests of the Japanese authorities for the rigorous
suppression of the activities of the secret organs of the
Kuomintang.

The continued acts of terrorism in the
International Settlement is a sign of the inefficiency of
the police precautions, and this is due to the lack of
sincerity on the part of the Settlement authorities.

This is a critical moment; toleration
can no longer be permitted. We lay particular stress on
this point in the hope that the Settlement authorities
will instantly rectify their attitude, thereby maintaining
the friendly relations existing between them and the
Japanese authorities and preserving their own prestige.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

换句话说，他们未能真诚地接受日本当局关于严厉镇压国民党秘密机关活动的要求。

国际租界内持续发生的恐怖行为是警力预防措施效率低下的标志，这是由于租界当局缺乏诚意所致。
